nodes.label: Conductor (README overview)
nodes.rationale: Positioned as a discipline system that forces any AI agent to classify a task up front and prove the result before claiming done, because agents otherwise report unverified work as finished.

nodes.label: Methodology layer (core laws, playbooks, method dispatcher)
Proportional verification
nodes.rationale: Verification volume is tied to the change's impact rather than to the act of committing, so a label edit needs only diff inspection while behavior changes need affected-scenario checks; applicable prior results are reused.

nodes.label: Memory layer (inbox plus curated lessons)
nodes.rationale: Split into a one-line-per-lesson inbox written by every AI on the machine and a curated per-lesson store with an index, so capture stays cheap while retrieval stays structured; freshness is only a tie-breaker.

nodes.label: Values file requirement (global CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: The A/B baseline that passed all discipline traps without Conductor still had the values file present, so the observed discipline came from that text, not from the bare model; if rules duplicating it were dropped and the file then deleted, discipline would vanish with no error from installer or linter.

nodes.label: conductor CLI update and rollback
nodes.rationale: Updates fetch the official main branch into a separate temporary folder so the user's working repository is untouched; a backup is written before any change, manually edited managed files stop the command instead of being overwritten, and later foreign edits block a rollback rather than being erased.

nodes.label: conductor/evidence/cli.py (verification evidence store)
nodes.rationale: Stores the real run, its output and snapshots of declared inputs so a still-applicable result can be reused; deliberately not an activity log and not an automatic test skip, and MATCH means observed conditions coincide, not that a new test passed. Storage stays local and outside the project because arguments and output may contain secrets.

nodes.label: Commit discipline
nodes.rationale: Kept as a textual rule after the marker-file git gate was removed: field data showed agents already performed proving runs, so the lock added an extra marker file that confirmed nothing and broke commits when forgotten.

nodes.label: Reply language switch
nodes.rationale: Rule files are written wholly in English because the model reasons in the language of its instructions and a Russian rule corpus dragged visible thinking into Russian even when another reply language was chosen. The language is one substituted phrase, so editing it by hand in the repo breaks the installer's substitution and --language stops switching.

nodes.label: Memory transfer to another machine
nodes.rationale: Conductor sources and personal memory are separate repositories, so the private memory repo is restored first into a new or empty folder and only then is Conductor installed; non-empty destinations are not overwritten.

nodes.label: Repository structure and source of truth
nodes.rationale: Edits are allowed only in runtime/ and adapters/core-body.md, then digests are rebuilt, linted and installed, because the repository is the source of truth and live copies are always generated from it.
